'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=明晓}} is a quest-exclusive NPC who makes her first appearance during the {{Quest|Simulacrum of the Heart}}. 

==Profile==
Mingxiao is one of the members of the [[Celestials]]. She is based in [[Mengxuan Vale]], within the [[Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou]].
